notes.title: Upcoming update and trailer of our new game
notes.content:
Hello! We have a lot of news!
[h2]Trailer of Our New Game[/h2]
The first trailer of our new game Dungeon Forge is out!
Add the game to your wishlist, it’s very important for us.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3916470/Dungeon_Forge/
[h2]Liquor Store Simulator Update[/h2]
Don’t worry, we haven’t forgotten about Liquor Store Simulator. Right now we are working on a big content update. There’s still a lot to do, but we can’t leave you without new content! In the coming days, we will release a small update, but we won’t say what it will include. Be patient — the wait won’t be long!

Also, a [b]31% discount[/b] on our game is active right now!

notes.title: Our new game!
notes.content:
[h2]We are excited to present to you our new game – Dungeon Forge![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3916470/Dungeon_Forge

This is a blacksmith simulator where you craft weapons for heroes.

You’ll customize weapons against unique enemies using enchantments, various sharpening techniques, and other upgrades!

The game is still in an early stage of development, but we’re planning to prepare a demo soon.

In the meantime, add the game to your wishlist – it’s very important for us!

P.S. Don’t worry, we haven’t abandoned Liquor Store Simulator. We continue improving the game, and a major update will be released this fall.

notes.title: 🍾 Liquor Store Simulator is OUT NOW! 🍾
notes.content:
[h2][b]The doors are open – your liquor store is ready for business! 🏪[/b][/h2]

[previewyoutube=4FdHZi3AFq0;full][/previewyoutube]

In Liquor Store Simulator, you start with a small shop, but if you play your cards right, you could turn it into a thriving alcohol empire. Buy products, stock shelves, set prices, and manage your employees to maximize profits.

But running a liquor store isn’t just about selling – you’ll need to watch the market, compete with rivals, and make smart investments to stay ahead. Will your store be the go-to spot for customers, or will you get lost in the competition?

[b] 🥃 Order, stock, and sell a variety of drinks[/b] – build the best selection in town!
[b] 👨‍💼 Hire and manage staff[/b] – keep your store running smoothly!
[b] 💰 Expand and dominate the liquor market[/b] – become a true business mogul!

Start your journey today and see if you have what it takes to build a liquor empire!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53111/Recycling_your_Liquor/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53112/Liquor_in_Laundry_Store/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53315/Liquor_x_Ecommerce/

notes.title: 🏪 Liquor Store Simulator – Releasing on May 2! 🏪
notes.content:
[h3]Your liquor store dream is about to become a reality! 🍾 [b]Liquor Store Simulator launches on May 2![/b][/h3]

From buying and selling products to managing inventory, hiring employees, and setting prices, this game puts you in charge of your very own liquor business. Will you build a small, cozy shop or create a booming alcohol empire?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3124550/Liquor_Store_Simulator/

[b]Stay tuned for the grand opening[/b] – the competition is fierce, and only the best will succeed!

notes.title: v0.3.4p Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello! Thank you all for your feedback and bug reports. We continue to improve the prologue and with this update we've made the following changes:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with saving licenses
[*] Fixed the display of prices in the price change window when starting a new save
[*] Fixed the display of the quantity of goods on shelves and in storage in purchase cards after reloading a save
[*] Fixed the update of interaction text for several objects (when changing language during gameplay)
[*] Added document highlighting during first interaction
[/list]

notes.title: 🚨 Liquor Store Simulator: Prologue Released! 🍷🍻
notes.content:
[h3]Hey, everyone! We're excited to announce that the Prologue of Liquor Store Simulator is now live and ready for you to try! 🎮[/h3]

Step into the shoes of a liquor store owner and experience the thrill of running your very own business. We've worked hard to create an engaging and fun experience, and now we need YOUR feedback to make it even better! 💬✨

Play the Prologue, share your thoughts, and let us know what you think. Your feedback is super important as we continue to improve and expand the game! 🚀

[h2][b]And remember to stay current add the full game to your wishlist[/b][/h2]
👉https://store.steampowered.com/app/3124550/Liquor_Store_Simulator/

We can’t wait to hear from you and see how you’re enjoying the game. Cheers to a new adventure! 🍹
